run_eval_retriever: run the DrQA retriever evaluation script on a dataset with a tfidf model and doc database
run_regex_match: run the regex_match function to test if a pattern is contained within a text string
run_has_answer: run the has_answer function to check if a document contains a given answer string
run_get_score: run the get_score function to search top retrieved docs for a matching answer
run_init_workers: run the init function to initialize tokenizer and document database in multiprocessing workers
